header.name: Load or Unload  Source in Fuuz
header.description:
This flow supports both Loading and Unloading Source in Fuuz

Load Source:

1. Create Production Setup Material
2. Create Workcenter history of the Load
3. Create Inventory Transaction

UnLoad Source:

1. Retrieve Existing Material
2. Delete Production Setup Material
3. Create Workcenter History of the unload
4.  Create Inventory Transaction
